The guide offers a choice of the Frozen Dawn Scimitar with Hawk Eye, or the Frozen Dawn Longsword with a sword ability; a quest here gives no choice, so neither is given.

quests.name: Forestrunner's Boots
quests.offer: Merchant Skysparkle has forestrunner's boots for you; they are free.
quests.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Speak with Merchant Skysparkle.
Show Forestrunner's Boots to Eterin Nitegazer.

quests.name: The Book of the Stars
quests.offer: Kelkor, in a small elven village north of the observatory on the mountain, has work.
quests.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Speak with Kelkor.
steps.says: Get me the book of the stars the gnomes keep in their observatory, and 140 tunar.

steps.journal: Speak with gnomish astronomer.
steps.says: The book of the stars? Take good care of it.

steps.journal: Bring Book of the Stars and 140 tunar to Kelkor.
steps.says: Take this locked chest to Eterin.

steps.journal: Bring Locked Chest to Eterin Nitegazer.

quests.name: Fibble's Device
quests.offer: Fibble Gearcharmer in Kara Village needs help.
quests.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Speak with Fibble Gearcharmer.
steps.says: Three orc thieves south of Kara took my device.

steps.journal: Collect Gearcharmer's Device from Orc Thieves.
Speak with Fibble Gearcharmer.
steps.says: It's broken. Take it to Gligbin Gearcharmer in Klik'Anon; 197 tunar.

steps.journal: Bring Gearcharmer's Device and 197 tunar to Gligbin Gearcharmer.
steps.says: I need resin from a witchdoctor in the cave near Fayspire.

steps.journal: Collect Witchdoctor's Resin from orc witchdoctors.
Bring Witchdoctor's Resin to Gligbin Gearcharmer.
Bring Repaired Device to Fibble Gearcharmer.
steps.says: Thank you! Go back to the one who sent you.

steps.journal: Speak with Eterin Nitegazer.

quests.offer: Siltha, in the little elf town north of Tethelin, needs help.
quests.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
quests.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Speak with Siltha.
steps.says: Four wings of the royal guard wasps from the hive near Tethelin.

Bring 4 Royal Wasp Guard Wings to Siltha.
steps.says: Now the spyglass of the orc gatewatcher in the Druk cave.

steps.journal: Collect Spyglass from orc gatewatchers.
Bring Spyglass to Siltha.
steps.says: Last, the skull of Vitsh Sah, from his tomb north of the cave.

steps.journal: Collect Skull of Vitsh from Vitsh'Sahs.
Bring Skull of Vitsh to Siltha.

Bring Necromancer's Handbook to Yiprew Yuprew.
steps.says: Now Snafitzer, in his house on mechanical legs.

Bring Snafitzer's Supplies to Snafitzer.

Bring Rib of a Crumbling Corpse to Yiprew Yuprew.

Bring Essence of a Marauding Soul to Yiprew Yuprew.
